input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

use_fire_download.description: Enable downloading files from EBI FIRE system (EBI network only).
use_fire_download.help_text: This feature is only available on the EBI network and is disabled by default. When enabled, the pipeline translates ENA FTP URLs and ENA HTTP URLs to EBI's FIRE S3 URLs and downloads assembly files directly from the FIRE system for faster download. Requires ENA FTP URLs or ENA HTTP links in the assembly_fasta column and FIRE_ACCESS_KEY/FIRE_SECRET_KEY environment variables.

contigs_filtering_thresholds.description: Set of threshold values used when filtering contigs.

bgc_min_contig_length.description: Minimum length of a contig to be analyzed by the Biosynthetic Gene Cluster subworkflow.

max_contig_n_content.description: Maximum ambiguous bases (N) content (as % of the total) allowed per contig; contigs with more N content than this will not be considered by the pipeline.

min_contig_length.description: Minimum length of a contig; contigs shorter than this will not be considered by the pipeline.

contigs_filtering_thresholds.title: Contigs Filtering Thresholds

decontamination.description: The pipeline includes the Microbiome Informatics assembly decontamination subworkflow to remove Human, PhyX and any host-associated data from the assemblies.

contaminant_reference.description: Name of the subfolder with the contaminant reference genome in FASTA format.

human_reference.description: Name of the subfolder with the human reference genome in FASTA format.

min_pid.description: Minimum percentage identity for sequence removal.
min_pid.help_text: Minimum percentage identity threshold used with min_qcov to select sequences for removal during decontamination.

min_qcov.description: Minimum query coverage for sequence removal.
min_qcov.help_text: Minimum query coverage threshold used with min_pid to select sequences for removal during decontamination.

phix_reference.description: Name of the subfolder with the PhiX reference genome in FASTA format.

reference_genomes_folder.description: Path to the folder containing the reference genomes subfolders. It must follow a specific structure — see README for details.
reference_genomes_folder.help_text: The folder where the reference genomes fasta files are stored

skip_decontamination.help_text: When set to true, assemblies will not be decontaminated.

decontamination.title: Assembly decontamination parameters

nucleotide_and_protein_fasta_file_chunki.description: Chunking input fasta files is used to parallelize the execution of some tools

bgc_contigs_chunksize.description: Number of nucleotide base pairs each chunk should contain. The proteins are not truncated, and this is the maximum value a record can have per chunk.

proteins_chunksize.description: Number of amino acids each chunk should contain. The proteins are not truncated, and this is the maximum value a record can have per chunk.

nucleotide_and_protein_fasta_file_chunki.title: Nucleotide and protein fasta file chunking options

tools_settings.description: Settings meant to tweak some parameters of the tools used in the pipeline.

cgc_merge_priority.help: The gene caller merge priority for the combined gene caller

fraggenescanrs_train_model.help: Specify the training model to use for gene prediction. Default is 'illumina_5'.

mpt_version.help: Keeps all mpt tools updated and synced to chosen release.

tools_settings.title: Settings for some of the tools of the pipeline

reference_databases.description: Paths to the different reference databases needed for the pipeline

antismash_database.description: Path to user-defined local antiSMASH database.
antismash_database.help_text: Pre downloaded antiSMASH databases, download from https://nf-co.re/funcscan/usage#antismash-1 or from our the Microbiome Informatics FTP.

antismash_database_version.description: The version of the antiSMASH database.

cat_database_version.description: The CAT_pack prepare database datastamp (YYYY_MM), as they are not versioned.

cat_diamond_database.description: Directory containing the CAT database produced with catpack/prepare.
cat_diamond_database.help: The folder must contain DIAMOND db *.dmnd, *.fastaid2LCAtaxid, *.taxids_with_multiple_offspring.

cat_taxonomy_database.description: Directory containing the tax/ folder of the CAT database produced with catpack/prepare.
cat_taxonomy_database.help: The folder must contain names.dmp and nodes.dmp

dram_databases.description: Path to user-defined local DRAM databases folder.
dram_databases.help_text: DRAM version 1.3 databases, these are required to run the distill module

dram_databases_version.description: The version of the DRAM databases.

eggnog_database.help_text: Set this variable to the path of the uncompressed tarball for the database.

eggnog_diamond_database.description: The eggnog Diamond protein database file

go_banding.description: Text file containing the GO terms and descriptions that make up the input GO-slim
go_banding.help_text: Path to the GO terms and descriptions, to make the GO-slim

go_obo.description: Gene ontology .OBO file, for example go-basic. Can usually be downloaded here https://geneontology.org/docs/download-ontology/

goslim_ids.description: Text file containing the GO terms that make up the input GO-slim
goslim_ids.help_text: Path to the GO terms txt file, to make the GO-slim

goslim_version.description: Version of the GO slim release used.
goslim_version.help: Specify the version of the GO slim release used.

interpro_licensed_software.description: Enables the use of licensed software in InterProScan. Set to true if the required licensed software is in the licensed database folder, https://interproscan-docs.readthedocs.io/en/v5/HowToRun.html#included-analyses.

interproscan_database_version.description: The version of the interproscan database.

ko_list_txt.description: KEGG Orthologs list, this is the TSV that you can obtain from ftp://ftp.genome.jp/pub/db/kofam/ko_list.gz
ko_list_txt.help_text: This file is used to get the descriptions from the KO entries in this pipeline summary files.

kofam_hmm_database.description: KEGG Orthologs HMM models, as generated by https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/reference-databases-preprocessing-pipeline
kofam_hmm_database.help_text: Path to the HMM file that contaisn the KOFam models.

kofam_hmm_database_version.description: Version of the KOFam models used, they are not version so this is the download date.
kofam_hmm_database_version.help: Specify the date YYYY_MMMM when the models where downloaded from KEGG.

rheachebi_mapping_tsv.description: This TSV file contains the mapping between RHEA terms and Chebi accesions.
rheachebi_mapping_tsv.help_text: Path to the TSV file that contains the the mapping between RHEA terms and Chebi accesions.

rfam_claninfo.description: Path to the Rfam clan information file.
rfam_claninfo.help: This file provides information about the clans of RNA families in the Rfam database.

rfam_covariance_models.description: Path to the Rfam covariance models file to use with cmsearch/cmscan.
rfam_covariance_models.help: This file contains the covariance model for RNA families from the Rfam database.

rfam_version.description: Version of the Rfam database being used.
rfam_version.help: Specify the version of the Rfam database to ensure compatibility with the models.

uniref90rhea_diamond_database.description: This is a diamond database created from the Uniref90 ammended with Rhea and CHEMI annotations.
uniref90rhea_diamond_database.help_text: Path to user-defined local Uniref90 + Rhea and CHEMI annotations diamond database file.

uniref90rhea_diamond_database_version.description: The version of the UniRef90 used to generate the database.

reference_databases.title: Reference databases for the pipeline

generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_nfschema_print_summary.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_config.description: By default we don't record the parameters in the multiqc report, as in production (MGnify) we have paths.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

generic_options.title: Generic options

institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
